fetched.title: EFF: Flock Safety ALPR Surveillance Report
fetched.content: Flock Safety operates one of the largest privately-owned ALPR networks in the United States, with cameras deployed in over 4,000 communities. This report examines retention policies, data-sharing agreements with law enforcement, and the civil liberties implications of widespread automated surveillance...
